name: Eargo 7

price.headline: $1,650 per pair
price.note: Financing available. OTC (over-the-counter); no prescription required.

key_facts.label: Hearing levels served
key_facts.value: Mild to moderate high-frequency hearing loss

pros: Completely in-canal design is nearly invisible
Good fit for high-frequency hearing loss, which is the most common type
Lifetime support from hearing professionals included
cons: In-canal fit is not right for all ear canal shapes
best_for: people with high-frequency hearing loss who want a nearly invisible aid
skip_if: your hearing loss affects all frequencies or is severe; consult an audiologist
rating_reason: The nearly invisible design and professional support are strong. Higher price point than competitors and limited to a specific hearing loss profile.
